metadata.question: Was the cone of Mount Vesuvius, located 12 kilometers southeast of Naples, Italy, visible with Landsat 8 on January 2, 2022?

data.raw_code: The user is asking if Mount Vesuvius was visible with Landsat 8 on January 2, 2022. This is about cloud cover/visibility rather than vegetation or other analysis. Strategy: 1. Use Landsat 8 Collection 2 Tier 1 SR data 2. Define the location of Mount Vesuvius (40.821°N, 14.426°E) 3. Check for images on January 2, 2022 4. Use the QA_PIXEL band to assess cloud cover over the volcano 5. If cloud cover is minimal, the volcano was likely visible Data quality considerations: - Check if collection is empty (C1) - Check if there are valid pixels after cloud masking (C2) - Validate that cloud percentage calculations are reasonable (C3) For visibility assessment, I'll calculate the percentage of clear pixels in a small area around the volcano summit. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const vesuvius = ee.Geometry.Point([14.426, 40.821]); // Mount Vesuvius coordinates const buffer = vesuvius.buffer(1000); // 1km buffer around the summit const date = '2022-01-02'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 8 Collection 2 const landsat8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(date, '2022-01-03'); const collectionSize = landsat8.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Get the image and process cloud mask const image = landsat8.first(); // Extract QA_PIXEL band and create cloud mask const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); // Bits for cloud detection in QA_PIXEL (Collection 2) const cloudBit = 1 << 5; // Bit 5: Cloud const cloudShadowBit = 1 << 3; // Bit 3: Cloud shadow const snowBit = 1 << 4; // Bit 4: Snow // Create cloud mask (1 = clear, 0 = cloud/cloud shadow/snow) const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBit).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudShadowBit).eq(0)) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(snowBit).eq(0)); // 4. Calculate cloud statistics over the buffer area const stats = cloudMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: buffer, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const clearPercentage = stats.get('QA_PIXEL_mean').getInfo(); const totalPixels = stats.get('QA_PIXEL_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Clear pixel percentage: ${(clearPercentage * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); console.log(`Total pixels analyzed: ${totalPixels}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (totalPixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (clearPercentage === null || clearPercentage === undefined || clearPercentage < 0 || clearPercentage > 1) { console.log("C3"); } else if (clearPercentage > 0.1) { // If >10% clear, consider visible console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
